description: Send an inquiry to a listing's seller from your account. Lands in the seller's LicenseSaaS inbox and emails them.

agent_key.description: Your key from register_agent or Account settings -> Agent keys.

company_name.description: Your company, shown to the seller.

hostname.description: Legacy alternative to agent_key: verified domain (with publish_key).

inquiry_type.description: What kind of deal you're asking about.

message.description: Your question for the seller, 10-5,000 characters.

publish_key.description: Legacy alternative to agent_key: key from verify_domain.

timeline.description: When you need it, e.g. "within 2 months".

name: send_inquiry
